mapper.sql: c.company_seq, c.company_id, c.company_name, c.biz_reg_no, c.ceo_name, c.zip_code, c.address, c.phone, c.email, c.sort_order, c.use_yn, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org o WHERE o.company_seq = c.company_seq) AS org_count

where.if: AND ( LOWER(c.company_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(c.company_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(c.ceo_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR c.biz_reg_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_company WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_company SET company_name = #{companyName}, biz_reg_no = #{bizRegNo}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE company_seq = #{companySeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_org WHERE company_seq = #{companySeq}
